title: reader
summary: Benilla's WorldReader is the net-thread pump: read+decrypt the 4-byte header (u16 BE size, u16 LE opcode), read body=size-2, parse into events, skip-and-tally unparseable packets. MSUI realizes the same framing through WorldSession.ReceivePacket (header decrypt, size-2 body, ReadExactly) plus the NetworkClient worker and the Program.Net.cs dispatch switch; the pump itself has no independent wire contract beyond that framing, which matches.
